units.source_text:
Tuesday afternoon at the familiar grocery entrance. A compact transition establishes an ordinary home stop to collect the work vest before this arrival: Taeo now carries the folded existing vest over LEFT forearm; Nib still carries his folded ruler RIGHT. No new bag or purchase. Both stop clear of the customer entrance. Taeo checks time on his phone in RIGHT, then pockets it in his jacket. They have arrived before four, without an exact new travel duration.

**TAEO | speech:** Made it.

**NIB | speech:** You still have to work.

Taeo looks at the vest and gives a tired little nod.

Inside the familiar shop. Taeo and Nib wait until the existing coworker has finished putting down a stock carton. Nib remains beside Taeo, not hidden behind a shelf.

**TAEO | speech:** Can he use the break room again? Just this shift.

**COWORKER | speech:** I'll ask.

One ordinary bounded permission, without a new manager face, application or conversation about Nib speaking.

lines.text: Can he use the break room again? Just this shift.

units.source_text:
A short continuous settling beat: coworker returns from the already established stockroom direction while Taeo puts on his vest, jacket now at the shop's established staff storage. Nib waits outside the break-room doorway with ruler held still at his side.

**COWORKER | speech:** Manager says yes. Leave the doorway clear.

**NIB | speech:** All right.

Nib walks in himself. No reprise of4's joke, no new job for him.

lines.text: Manager says yes. Leave the doorway clear.

units.source_text:
Nib sets the folded ruler on the existing low crate, well away from its edge, and sits on the established floor place beside it. Belt kit remains clear of his seated weight. Taeo pauses at the doorway, phone pocketed. Nib's hands are empty.

**TAEO | speech:** The drawings after work.

**NIB | speech:** I remember.

Taeo goes to his actual shop task. The beat is anticipation, not a promise that Nib will sit motionless for six hours.

One modest time-passage composition at the shop: Taeo restocks an ordinary low shelf, then a later connected view shows him removing the work vest at the end of the shift. Reuse existing customer silhouettes only if needed. In the earlier shop view, Nib is visible resting his back against the existing break-room wall, legs comfortably stretched clear of the doorway, ruler safe on the crate. He watches ordinary staff movement with half-closed eyes rather than staring toward Taeo for six hours. No delivery accident, unpaid overtime, paycheck, magical distraction or new shift schedule. In the later view Nib stands beside the break-room crate and picks the same ruler up in RIGHT. Taeo takes his jacket from staff storage and puts it on before leaving, phone still in its pocket. The phone remains Taeo's.

**CAPTION | time:** After ten.

Apartment entry, both arriving together. Taeo sets folded work vest with his existing work things, removes shoes at the established entry and hangs jacket. Phone is transferred from jacket into RIGHT hand before the jacket is hung. Nib crosses onto the indoor floor under his own power, ruler in RIGHT. Neither acquires a new costume. Ordinary night lighting and the existing cramped room establish return without an exterior city montage.

No dialogue. This is the actual work-to-home transition.

Taeo puts his phone face up on the existing reachable shared surface, screen dark. He takes one clean blank scrap and household pencil from ordinary storage. Nib lays his ruler flat beside, not on, that paper, then settles beside the surface. Original sketch and cash stay in his tied pouch. The exit remains unobstructed without an emphatic callback shot.

**TAEO | speech:** Start at the bay?

**NIB | speech:** Where they loaded the stretcher.

Taeo puts pencil down at the bay end of his blank sheet and begins the already reported service path: up the page, across to the left. Nib watches the pencil rather than Taeo's face. Keep the drawing at an oblique angle; no polished complete map appears instantly.

**TAEO | speech:** North. Then west.

**NIB | speech:** Then south. That last bit to the entrance.

Taeo completes that short south leg to a simple apron shape. Nib indicates the final joining point with an empty fingertip, without drawing through Taeo's hand. It matches what the field reports actually said.

**TAEO | speech:** I had that one.

**NIB | speech:** Good. Keep it.

Taeo's small pleased look survives the correction. Not every recollection is wrong.

lines.text: Then south. That last bit to the entrance.

units.source_text:
Taeo adds the main walking branch separately between apron and bay. He pauses where the fixed dogleg should be rather than confidently drawing a straight clear corridor.

**TAEO | speech:** This is the way you walked in. Why couldn't they carry the stretcher back here?

Nib brings his empty RIGHT hand above the page, fingers stopping short of the pencil point.

lines.text: This is the way you walked in. Why couldn't they carry the stretcher back here?

units.source_text:
Nib traces a short offset in the air above that branch with his fingertip, then lets Taeo draw it. The reconstruction does not introduce a new corridor or redraw the broad service bend as narrow.

**NIB | speech:** Two stone shoulders. You turn between them. We could walk through. The stretcher couldn't turn flat.

Taeo draws the offset slowly, adjusting the second line rather than erasing the entire route.

lines.text: Two stone shoulders. You turn between them. We could walk through. The stretcher couldn't turn flat.

units.source_text:
Nib turns his folded ruler lengthwise above the sheet as a plain physical example, keeping it folded and clear of faces. It is NOT a scale model of the medical frame. He lowers it flat outside the paper when he finishes speaking.

**NIB | speech:** They tried it empty. Before they moved the worker.

**TAEO | speech:** I didn't hear that part.

Nib meets his eyes. This is the first direct debrief of the local13U15 exchange that never reached Taeo by radio.

lines.text: They tried it empty. Before they moved the worker.

units.source_text:
Taeo leaves the dogleg's interior spacing rough. He starts to tighten two boundary lines, then holds the pencil still.

**TAEO | speech:** How wide was it?

**NIB | speech:** I didn't measure it.

**TAEO | speech:** Right.

No invented numeric width, dimension label, magic memory or retrospectively carried ruler.

Taeo makes one small ordinary question mark beside the uncertain clearance, keeping the route line itself intact. The question mark is lettering on the eventual hand-drawn prop, not an information overlay. Nib watches him leave the uncertainty in place. The ruler lies folded at the sheet's side; the page is not a certified survey.

No dialogue. Keep this short, part of the same drawing action.

Taeo adds the distinct low bypass below the main branch, stopping its eastern end at the bay's south edge. His pencil hovers over that end. Nib's gaze goes there too.

**TAEO | speech:** I nearly sent you back for the samples.

**NIB | speech:** You told me to leave them.

This refers to13's actual abandoned pickup exchange, not an invented order Nib obeyed.

lines.text: I nearly sent you back for the samples.
You told me to leave them.

units.source_text:
Taeo sets the pencil down instead of continuing to talk over the sketch.

**TAEO | speech:** I was still trying to keep the bonus. I'm sorry.

Nib studies him for a moment. His hands remain on his own side of the surface.

**NIB | speech:** I wanted the money too. I wasn't leaving them there.

No moral slogan, penalty, lost base wage, forgiven debt or accusation that Taeo caused the injury.

lines.text: I was still trying to keep the bonus. I'm sorry.
I wanted the money too. I wasn't leaving them there.

units.source_text:
Taeo nods once. He looks at the long line they actually used, leaving the sample thought behind.

**TAEO | speech:** Tell me where you waited.

Nib points beside the first broad bend, outside the future carrying path, not in front of a stretcher icon.

**NIB | speech:** Here. Minho wanted me where he could see me.

The question moves the debrief forward; no second apology.

lines.text: Here. Minho wanted me where he could see me.

units.source_text:
Taeo indicates the bend with the pencil without touching Nib's finger.

**TAEO | speech:** When I felt it?

**NIB | speech:** Near there. I had my hand on the support. Then we stopped, and I saw the mark on the floor.

The ordinary scuff and stop are recalled in order. No assertion that Taeo saw or held the support, no force-sharing revelation, and no claim that the first touch was a deliberate test.

Taeo makes a little point beside that bend, then hesitates before writing more. Nib draws his hand back.

**TAEO | speech:** I still don't know what part I felt.

**NIB | speech:** Neither do I.

Taeo leaves it as a location in the recollection, not a warning symbol that certifies a new ability. Both hands remain ordinary. Keep their shared uncertainty unadorned.

lines.text: Near there. I had my hand on the support. Then we stopped, and I saw the mark on the floor.
I still don't know what part I felt.

units.source_text:
Nib looks along the route to its end. He nudges the folded ruler clear so Taeo can finish the apron line comfortably. Taeo adds no unseen boss corridor or invented measurements.

**NIB | speech:** After the turn, we slowed down. Then we stopped once more by the entrance.

**TAEO | speech:** I heard that call.

The last remembered rest belongs to14U25–26, not a new event.

lines.text: After the turn, we slowed down. Then we stopped once more by the entrance.

units.source_text:
One calm complete view of the rough sheet and both people. The north-west-south service route is continuous; distinct main dogleg and southern bypass stay distinct. The uncertain spacing remains visibly rough. No miniature patient, exact carrier clearance, official logo or dimensions. Taeo follows the final line with his eyes and finally sets the pencil down beside it.

**TAEO | speech:** That's all the way out.

**NIB | speech:** That's the way we used.

A bounded piece of work is actually finished. It is a memory aid, not qualification.

Taeo turns from the paper to his phone and wakes it with his RIGHT hand. Nib shifts closer to see, without abandoning or handing over his ruler. Taeo opens the same six-entry public recording link from Chae. Use the known page structure; do not add an unread message, new search result or selectable magic interface.

**TAEO | speech:** The recordings.

Nib's attention sharpens. The promise is acted on before fatigue ends the evening.

Before starting any recording, Taeo yawns and tries to close his mouth around it. Nib looks at him instead of the screen. There is no cute sleepy collapse, drooling or claim that Nib is a child who needs bedtime.

**NIB | speech:** You won't remember this either.

**TAEO | speech:** I'm awake.

Nib waits a beat, plainly unconvinced.

Taeo looks at the phone, then back at Nib, and stops trying to perform alertness. The six-entry list remains open and unplayed.

**TAEO | speech:** Morning? Before we do anything else.

**NIB | speech:** Before your next drawing.

**TAEO | speech:** Yes.

This is Nib accepting a specific ordinary postponement, not another promise postponed without his knowledge.

lines.text: Morning? Before we do anything else.

units.source_text:
Taeo locks the phone and places it beside the finished route sheet. Nib picks the folded ruler up with RIGHT and moves it to the existing safe resting spot beside his own bedding, clear of anyone's feet. His tied personal pouch and sheathed blade stay worn; any removal for sleep is outside this scene and not silently shown.

No dialogue. The route paper and the ruler remain two people's separate work, in the same small room.

Final generous domestic two-shot. Taeo has moved the finished sheet away from the shared surface's usable edge. Nib settles beside his bedding, looking once toward the now-cleared space where they will watch. Taeo switches off only the task light if an accepted lamp exists; otherwise keep the same ordinary room light and end on his hand resting away from the pencil. No new light fixture is needed.

**NIB | speech:** You got the last turn right.

**TAEO | speech:** I wrote it down three times today.

A small dry exchange, no laughter pose required. End with the debrief completed and tomorrow's first use of the space chosen together.

lines.text: You got the last turn right.
I wrote it down three times today.
